name: Dwight H. Little
bio: Dwight Hubbard Little (born January 13, 1956) is an American film director, known for directing the films Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers (1988), The Phantom of the Opera (1989), Marked for Death (1990) and Rapid Fire (1992). He has also directed episodes of various TV series including 24, Prison Break, Bones, Dollhouse and Castle.
